fusions.name: Leaping Lash
fusions.desc: Whips a red-hot length that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds, then leaps to 3 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage. Your afflictions on the first target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Heated Manacle
fusions.desc: A lash of heated links with your weapon that deals 4 damage, sets the target [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Glowing Tether
fusions.desc: Stretches a red-hot length 6 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward. Anything it catches is set [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds and moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: One Catches the Next
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict an enemy, a spark leaps to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 5 damage, then to 2 more within 3 tiles for 50% of that. Once every 3 seconds.
